knowledge_crystallization.epiphany_1_trisector: The cognitive engine is Trisector, not bisector. Left (Neji/Y789), Right (Shikamaru/Nexus), and Invariant (Itachi/Heimdall/Rodin/Celestial). Cheshire Kernel acts as Thalamus bridging all three.
knowledge_crystallization.epiphany_2_linking_pathway: Itachi Eye and Celestial Clock are NOT destinations. They are the habenular pathway (linking components) that interconnect Rodin (Pineal/WHERE) to Heimdall (Hippocampus/WHAT), forging 4D knowledge nodes.
knowledge_crystallization.epiphany_3_swarm_commander: Rodin is a Swarm Commander. It does not parse isolation. It knows the spatial topology of the Hoard manifold and dispatches swarm agents to retrieve nodes, driving the cyclical K->U->W progression.
knowledge_crystallization.epiphany_4_daemons: Dragon, Heimdall, and Rodin are ALWAYS-ON Agentic Daemons. They have no user-facing output but possess managerial autonomy.
knowledge_crystallization.epiphany_5_two_key_phoenix: Phoenix Engine is NOT a daemon. It requires a strict two-key operation: 'Jean Grey: Operation Phoenix Force' + Cheshire Protocol dACC co-sign. It cannot act unilaterally.
